# Remote SSH MCP

Canonical documentation: https://kogeler.github.io/remote-ssh-mcp-server/
Source: https://github.com/kogeler/remote-ssh-mcp-server

Remote SSH MCP exposes bounded remote-machine operations to MCP clients over
one explicitly authenticated OpenSSH master. It supports CPython 3.13 and 3.14.
